test: decompengine.acp.AcpAgentHarnessTest.public ACP reconstruction enforces mutation grants and preserves publication on limit outcomes
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.acp.AcpAgentHarnessTest.public ACP reconstruction enforces mutation grants and preserves publication on limit outcomes'

scope.provider: scripted ACP process with host-side final-snapshot injection
scope.scenario: After the scripted ACP target write is acknowledged, the host replaces the staged implementation with a FIFO created by /usr/bin/mkfifo. Final snapshot refuses it as WORKSPACE_VIOLATION with reason special-file.
scope.receipt: The request-bound and non-null turn-identity-bound receipt reports final-workspace-snapshot, has no complete execution evidence, and retains the original allowed/completed target-write audit.
scope.rollback: Accepted output metadata remains unchanged; no publication residue remains.
scope.cleanup: ACP process stopped, no owned processes remain, and sandbox cleanup is verified.
qualificationLimits: host-side injection is not an agent-accessible mutation
